definitions.gloss: chemical formula; a symbolic representation of the composition of a chemical compound
definitions.explanation: chemical formula; a symbolic representation of the composition of a chemical compound

examples.japanese: {水|みず}の{化学式|かがくしき}はH2Oだ。
examples.english: The chemical formula for water is H₂O.

examples.japanese: {化学式|かがくしき}を{覚|おぼ}えるのが{苦手|にがて}だ。
examples.english: I'm bad at memorizing chemical formulas.

examples.japanese: {中学|ちゅうがく}の{理科|りか}で{初|はじ}めて{化学式|かがくしき}の{書|か}き{方|かた}を{習|なら}った。
examples.english: I first learned how to write chemical formulas in middle school science class.

notes:
A compound of {化学|かがく} (chemistry) and {式|しき} (formula/expression). One of the foundational terms in Japanese science education, introduced in middle school ({中学校|ちゅうがっこう}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {化学式|かがくしき}を{書|か}く — to write a chemical formula
- {化学式|かがくしき}で{表|あらわ}す — to express in chemical formula
- {分子式|ぶんしし} — molecular formula
- {構造式|こうぞうしき} — structural formula

RELATED WORDS:
- {化学|かがく}{反応式|はんのうしき} — chemical reaction equation
- {元素|げんそ}{記号|きごう} — element symbol
- {化学|かがく}{方程式|ほうていしき} — chemical equation
